t: This entry is for His Majesty's Prison Service, the part of government that manages most of the prisons in England and Wales. It forms part of HM Prison and Probation Service. Theodore Schurch died in custody connected with this service in 1946. He was a British soldier who was executed under the Treachery Act 1940 after the Second World War ended. He was the last person executed in Britain for an offence other than murder. The material doesn't say which prison, so I'll say no more about the site itself.
